title: IVRESS Spin a Tale
promptLanguage: Set a dark WebGL scene that stays still until a click, then let scroll move through a short run of held chapters while a visible control owns the sound. Keep a large tracked title and a small chapter index in front of the picture, with a still frame when motion is off.
notes: Nine numbered scenes share one dark canvas, with a start gate, a sound control, and a hold gesture in a later scene. Chapter names and closing links stay readable while the canvas carries the pictures.
reducedMotion: Reduced motion keeps the chapter index and story lines in place and shows the scene as a still frame.
creditLine: Laugh Mind, Utsubo, IVRESS SPIN A TALE (https://thefwa.com/cases/ivress-spin-a-tale)
